title: Polynomial Resource Classification of Quantum Circuit Familes via Classical Shadows
summary: We compare four polynomial-resource measurement strategies, (I) $Z$-basis-only, (II) nearest-neighbor $ZZ$ (NN), (III) multi-basis ($Z$, $X$, $Y$), and (IV) classical shadows, for classifying three quantum circuit families: IQP, Clifford, and Clifford$+T$. We find $Z$-only measurements outperform multi-basis and classical shadows across all qubit counts and all four classifiers evaluated, and the $O(\nqubits)$-feature NN strategy matches $Z$-only to within $0.02$ in Random Forest accuracy.
